events.description: Judy Geller says Martha Ludwin's daughter is going to call Monica Geller.
Judy Geller asks what the curry taste in the food is.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller thinks the food Monica Geller cooked is great.
Ross Geller asks Monica Geller whether Monica Geller remembers the Ludwins.
Ross Geller says Martha Ludwin's older daughter had a crush on Ross Geller.
Judy Geller says Martha Ludwin's daughters all had a crush on Ross Geller.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is sorry.
Judy Geller says Martha Ludwin's daughter just graduated.
Judy Geller says Martha Ludwin's daughter wants a career in cooking or food.
Judy Geller says Judy Geller does not know the exact details about Martha Ludwin's daughter's plans.
Judy Geller says Judy Geller told Martha Ludwin's daughter that Monica Geller has a restaurant.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller does not have a restaurant.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller works in a restaurant.
Judy Geller says the Ludwin family does not have to know that Monica Geller works in a restaurant rather than owning one.
Monica Geller asks Ross Geller to come help Monica Geller.
Monica Geller asks Ross Geller to help Monica Geller with the spaghetti.
Judy Geller says Ross Geller, Jack Geller, Judy Geller, and Monica Geller are having spaghetti.
Judy Geller says the spaghetti meal is easy.
Monica Geller says her request is going to sound unbelievably selfish.
Monica Geller asks whether Ross Geller is planning to bring up the situation that Carol Willick is a lesbian and is pregnant with Ross Geller's child.
Monica Geller says that Ross Geller bringing up that situation might take some of Judy Geller and Jack Geller's criticism off Monica Geller.
Judy Geller criticizes what Rachel Green did to Rachel Green's life.
Judy Geller says Judy Geller and Jack Geller ran into Rachel Green's parents at the club.
Judy Geller says Rachel Green's parents were not playing very well at the club.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller is not going to tell Judy Geller and Jack Geller what Rachel Green's parents spent on Rachel Green's wedding.
Ross Geller says Rachel Green's parents spent a lot of money on Rachel Green's wedding.
Ross Geller says forty thousand dollars is a lot of money.
Judy Geller says Rachel Green at least had the chance to leave Barry Farber at the altar.
Monica Geller asks what Judy Geller's comment is supposed to mean.
Judy Geller says Judy Geller's previous comment is just an expression.
Monica Geller says Judy Geller's previous comment is not an expression.
Ross Geller tells Monica Geller not to listen to Judy Geller.
Ross Geller says Monica Geller is independent.
Ross Geller says Monica Geller was a kid.
Ross Geller says Monica Geller was chubby when Monica Geller was a child.
Ross Geller says Monica Geller had no friends when Monica Geller was a child.
Ross Geller says Monica Geller was just fine despite having no friends.
Ross Geller says Monica Geller would read alone in Monica Geller's room.
Ross Geller says there are people like Ross Geller who need to shoot for the stars with his museum career and ambitions.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller's academic papers are getting published.
Ross Geller says other people are satisfied with staying where they are.
Ross Geller tells Monica Geller this viewpoint.
Ross Geller says the people who are satisfied with staying where they are never get cancer.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller reads about women trying to have it all.
Ross Geller says these women try to have it all.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller thanks God.
Ross Geller says Monica Geller, whom the family calls 'Our Little Harmonica,' does not seem to have the problem of trying to have it all.
Monica Geller asks what is going on with Ross Geller.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller realizes Judy Geller, Jack Geller, and Monica Geller have been wondering what happened between Ross Geller and Carol Willick.
Ross Geller says Judy Geller, Jack Geller, and Monica Geller have been wondering what exactly happened between Ross Geller and Carol Willick.
Ross Geller brings up what exactly happened between Ross Geller and Carol Willick.
Ross Geller says he is about to explain the situation between Ross Geller and Carol Willick.
Ross Geller says Carol Willick is a lesbian.
Ross Geller says Carol Willick is living with a woman named Susan Bunch.
Ross Geller says Carol Willick is pregnant with Ross Geller's child.
Ross Geller says Carol Willick and Susan Bunch are going to raise the baby.

Judy Geller asks Monica Geller whether Monica Geller knew about Ross Geller's news that Carol Willick is a lesbian, is living with Susan Bunch, is pregnant with Ross Geller's child, and that Carol Willick and Susan Bunch will raise the baby.
